neighbours.label: ' of' / ' de' right after 'year' / 'año' when the phrase names what the year was about ('the year of the great flood', 'Year of the Dragon', 'el año de la crisis'); quiet on partitive and other uses of 'of' and on 'year' without it
fire: For the town, 1953 was the year of the great flood.
People born in 2012 belong to the Year of the Dragon.
Historians call 1848 the year of revolutions in Europe.
For our family it was the year of the long move north.
The eighties were the years of the miners' strikes.
Para el club, 1998 fue el año de la gran victoria.
Muchos recuerdan 2001 como el año de la crisis bancaria.
The UN declared 2008 the International Year of the Potato.
quiet: For the town, 1953 was a terrible year because of the flood.
People born in 2012 are still at primary school.
Historians call 1848 a turning point for most of Europe.
For our family it was a long move north with lots of boxes.
The eighties were hard for many of the miners.
Para el club, 1998 fue un gran año con muchas victorias.
She bought a bag of potatoes and a bottle of milk.
The UN declared the region free of the disease in 2008.

notes: Card: 22 of the top 32 peaks are ' of' / ' de', in 'Plant of the Year', 'the years of ebb', 'the year of the Lowell conferences', 'el año de la preparación', 'le pays du goulag'. Probes: 'el año de la crisis' 0.98, 'Year of the Rat' 0.71, 'the year of the great drought' 0.61, 'Woman of the Year' 0.34, 'Land of Fire' 0.28; 'age of jazz' 0.10, 'Player of the Month' 0.11; 'some of', 'because of', 'cup of' 0.01. So the test is narrowed to 'year of'.
